purpose: Define a reproducible elevation model for ÖST routes when source GPX elevation is missing, partial or not comparable across devices/years.
principles: Horizontal route geometry and elevation provenance are separate layers.
Never alter horizontal coordinates merely to obtain elevation coverage.
Preserve source GPX elevation, participant/barometric elevation and standardized DEM elevation as separate observations.
Cross-year D+ comparisons must use one common DEM source and one common processing algorithm.
Raw watch/GPX D+ is diagnostic metadata unless the same acquisition and filtering method is demonstrably comparable.

processing.horizontal_resampling: fixed interval; final interval to be selected by calibration, then held constant for all routes
processing.dem_sampling: sample the same Lantmäteriet ground DEM for all canonical route points
processing.smoothing_and_ascent_filter: pending calibration; one documented method must be used for every route version
processing.calibration_reference: 2025 Ultra organizer geometry plus project-owner Suunto barometric profile-shape reference

source_elevation_handling.organizer_gpx: retain unchanged as source elevation; do not assume raw cumulative D+ is authoritative
source_elevation_handling.participant_gps: retain as diagnostic/race-day evidence when provenance permits; barometric profiles may validate shape
source_elevation_handling.missing_or_partial_elevation: enrich the canonical horizontal geometry from the standardized DEM instead of borrowing elevations from a different route
source_elevation_handling.conflicting_values: do not overwrite; store provenance-specific observations side by side

current_known_examples.issue: Organizer GPX contains only partial elevation values and current raw GPX analysis cannot produce usable D+.
current_known_examples.action: Use organizer horizontal geometry and derive standardized elevation from the common DEM.

current_known_examples.issue: Organizer GPX contains full elevation but raw cumulative +1058/-942 m is method-dependent and not cross-year comparable.
current_known_examples.action: Keep raw source values as diagnostics and derive standardized elevation from the common DEM.

current_known_examples.issue: Dense barometric activity profile is valuable but cumulative ascent varies strongly with filtering/resampling.
current_known_examples.action: Use for profile-shape and filtering calibration, not as the universal elevation source.
